title: YOU DON’T WEAR THE ARMOR TO IMPRESS — YOU WEAR IT TO INVADE.
paragraphs:
YOU DON’T WEAR THE ARMOR TO IMPRESS — YOU WEAR IT TO INVADE.
Faith isn’t about looking strong — it’s about moving in strength.
You weren’t called to blend in.
You were called to advance.
When Heaven invades, darkness has no option but to retreat. ⚔️🔥

“Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.”
— Ephesians 6:11 ✝️
